notes: make format changed nothing (git status identical before and after). make check passed with exit code 0; the only warning in its output is rustup's routine 'default toolchain implicitly overridden' notice from the toolchain file, not a lint. No lint fixes were needed, so no fix round was spent. One commit, containing both the kernel fix and the all.txt edit together. Linux is cited as the reason the behavior is right -- the net_proto_family::create hook placement and the socketpair EPROTONOSUPPORT-vs-EOPNOTSUPP ordering measured on this container's 6.8 kernel -- and the body also records where the fix deliberately does not generalize (raw IP, IPv6 datagram, vsock datagram remain missing features with TODOs) and that socketpair01 stays blocked despite going green. gvisor_filter is null for this LTP run, so no case-subset note was needed.
